class.name: HorrorInteractable3D
class.brief_description: An object that can be focused and activated by [HorrorInteractor3D].
class.description: Place a [HorrorInteractable3D] above a [CollisionObject3D] in the scene tree, then connect [signal interacted] to the object's response. The collision object may be a child or another descendant.

method.name: set_interaction_enabled
method.description: Sets whether this object can be focused and activated.

method.name: set_interaction_prompt
method.description: Sets the text [HorrorInteractor3D] sends with its [signal HorrorInteractor3D.target_changed] signal.

method.name: get_interaction_prompt
method.description: Returns the text [HorrorInteractor3D] sends with its [signal HorrorInteractor3D.target_changed] signal.

method.name: interact
method.description: Emits [signal interacted] when interaction is enabled.

method.name: is_interaction_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the object can currently be focused and activated.

signal.name: interacted
signal.description: Emitted when [method interact] is called while interaction is enabled.
